clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, grouper are a familiar catch, though murloc attacks have driven fishermen from their boats. The fish is prized for food and sport, and a good haul is harder to find.

Darkshore Grouper are a welcome catch in the cold waters off Darkshore. Anglers around Auberdine value them for the simple dishes they make, and travelers and residents alike enjoy those meals. A fishing line and basic gear are enough to bring one in. For many fishermen, the pleasure of catching a grouper matches the pleasure of eating it.

Fishermen such as Gubber Blump once took small boats into deeper waters and brought back grouper by the dozen. Coastal murlocs have grown more aggressive, grounding most boats around Auberdine. Anglers now fish from shore and dock, where locals suspect the murlocs are eating the grouper. A good haul takes patience.
